svg.title: agent loop — observe, decide, guard, execute, ledger, repeat
svg.desc: A neofetch-style terminal card in neon: on the left, an ASCII agent loop with a glowing signal orbiting it; on the right, an ls -al listing of repos whose selection and an agent TUI card (official brand icons) cycle in sync with agent CLI commands typed at the prompt, over a permanent detail grid of stack and principles.
